profile.concavityEvidence: coarse visual estimate using available oblique product references
profile.profileEvidence: Individual local front and supporting profile/oblique source photos; visual proportions, not measured dimensions.
profile.profileObservation: Ten channelled arms and dark scalloped beadlock ring; only angled reference, hidden windows and depth remain inferred.
profile.hardwareObservation: 20 observed beadlock fasteners are already represented by 60 washer/head/socket surface details in the trace override; no duplicate row added.
profile.finishObservation: Visual preview finish selected from the reviewed photograph; exposure/shadows are not used as a literal metal colour. Production finish is configurable.

notes: The source is an angled product view. The hub is displaced by perspective and concavity; manual geometry restores a concentric face instead of copying this displacement.
Visible rear barrel material inside the front windows is removed. Hidden boundaries, depth and small surface grooves remain approximate.
